sentences.text: The skull of this ancient fish may have measured about 8.5 centimeters in length.
Scientists found a single, badly preserved fragment of a head in rock from Sichuan.
This creature belongs to the broad group known as Placodermi.
Some experts doubt if it fits within the Petalichthyida family.
A 1991 study placed it in that group but noted its uncertain position.
It might be closely related to Quasipetalichthys, yet their family link remains unclear.
Neopetalichthys yenmenpaensis lived in China during the Early Devonian period.
